body: Pioneer spacecraft carried a plaque with engraved diagrams. Voyager spacecraft carried Golden Records containing images and sounds. Voyager's cover provides diagrams intended to help a finder play the record and make sense of its stored images.

Centauri Archive is an independent project investigating a small self-describing record of Earth, life and humanity. Its digital development collection and experiments inform a proposed physical carrier. A feasibility proposal identifies Fermi Explorer as a possible collaborator. No archive payload allocation, approval or integration agreement is confirmed.
